import re
# Extract grids after labels from raw message text

def extract_pair(raw, label):
    tail=raw.split(label,1)[1]
    lines=tail.splitlines()
    rows=[]
    for line in lines:
        if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9 ]+',line.strip()): rows.append(list(map(int,line.split())))
        elif rows: break
    return rows
